training_data: NCGG Biobank (National Center for Geriatrics and Gerontology, Japan), blood RNA-seq: discovery cohort of 73 followed MCI (26 MCI-C / 47 MCI-NC), 5-fold CV to choose the marker combination
test_data: Validation cohort of 72 followed MCI (26 MCI-C / 46 MCI-NC) from the same NCGG Biobank
reason: The Cox model (IGK, TRA and WDR37 plus age, sex and APOE e4) and its risk cut-off were fixed on the discovery cohort, then applied to the validation cohort (C-index 0.643; log-rank P = 2.57e-3). Both cohorts come from the one NCGG Biobank, so this is a held-out partition of a single institution: V3, matching the 2026-09-27 audit recode already in the block. Leakage caveat: the WDR37 screen compared all 52 MCI-C and 93 MCI-NC, which include the validation cohort.

quotes.quote: We obtained 856 blood samples with measured mRNA expression and their associated clinical data from the NCGG Biobank.
All data were strictly separated into a discovery cohort and a validation cohort.
The adjusted model was then evaluated on a validation cohort of 72 subjects (26 MCI-C and 46 MCI-NC), which was completely independent from the discovery cohort.
during which time 52 (35.86%) converted to AD (i.e., were classified as MCI-C), and the remaining 93 MCI patients (64.14%) were classified as MCI-NC.
